017package org.apache.juneau.marshall.objecttools;
018
019import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
020
021/**
022 * Thrown by {@link ObjectIntrospector} when an attempt is made to invoke a method that has not been
023 * explicitly allow-listed.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * As of Juneau 10.0, {@link ObjectIntrospector} is secure-by-default: reflective method dispatch is refused
027 * unless the caller has explicitly allow-listed the methods that may be invoked.  This closes off
028 * reflective-invoke-over-the-wire exposure (e.g. a REST endpoint that feeds untrusted method/argument strings
029 * straight into an introspector).
030 *
031 * <h5 class='section'>How to fix:</h5><ul>
032 *    <li>
033 *       Allow-list the specific method(s) you intend to expose:
034 *       <p class='bjava'>
035 *          ObjectIntrospector.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>o</jv>).allow(MyBean.<jk>class</jk>, <js>"getName"</js>).invokeMethod(...);
036 *       </p>
037 *    <li>
038 *       Or, for trusted in-process callers only, restore the pre-10.0 behavior of allowing any public,
039 *       non-deprecated method:
040 *       <p class='bjava'>
041 *          ObjectIntrospector.<jsm>create</jsm>(<jv>o</jv>).allowAll().invokeMethod(...);
042 *       </p>
043 * </ul>
044 *
045 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
046 *    <li class='jc'>{@link ObjectIntrospector}
047 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/ObjectTools">Object Tools</a>
048 * </ul>
049 *
050 * @serial exclude
051 */
052@SuppressWarnings({
053   "java:S110" // Deep inheritance inherent to the exception hierarchy
054})
055public class MethodNotAllowlistedException extends BasicRuntimeException {
056
057   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
058
059   /**
060    * Constructor.
061    *
062    * @param message Message.
063    * @param args Message arguments.
064    */
065   public MethodNotAllowlistedException(String message, Object...args) {
066      super(message, args);
067   }
068
069   @Override /* Overridden from BasicRuntimeException */
070   public MethodNotAllowlistedException setMessage(String message, Object...args) {
071      super.setMessage(message, args);
072      return this;
073   }
074}
